documents.text: Young Graham is remarkably composed and naturalistic as Percy and the underrated Leguizamo makes the most of his best role in ages . The music is fabulously funky , creating the up-tempo mood that permeates the second half of the film . There really is a lot to like here , which makes it easy enough to overlook those aspects that go unexplained .
